where: Lowleaf's Verdant Lumenary hall; also the Pearlmoor Wanderwood and the Glowmoss bloom beats in Lowleaf Hollow
mood: The safe glow at the heart of the dark forest — a lantern-lit music-box lullaby in a gentle waltz; hearth over wonder.
core_styles: 16-bit console RPG soundtrack from the mid-1990s
retro sampled-chip instruments with the warm echo of a 16-bit sound chip
warm G major with a gentle minor turn
rounded music-box and soft pulse-wave lead singing a lullaby melody
gentle waltz synth bass falling root to fifth
soft brushes on beats two and three, a single chime per phrase
cosy lantern-lit village hearth, safe and homely

sections.name: Intro
sections.text: {a music-box winds up: a gentle rising arpeggio, one warm chime, and a soft held chord that eases into the waltz}

sections.name: Main Theme
sections.text: {the lullaby melody in lilting 3/4: a hopeful rising leap that settles home rounded and even, tuneful and cosy, the bass rocking the waltz}

sections.name: Main Theme Reprise
sections.text: {the lullaby again with a soft flute harmony a third below and harp joining the arpeggio, warmer and fuller like a hearth fire}

sections.name: Bridge
sections.text: {contrast: a gentle turn to E minor, a wistful little phrase on the pulse lead, quieter, a breath of homesickness, then lifting back to G major}

sections.name: Main Theme Return
sections.text: {the lullaby returns, settled and warm; the last bar leads straight back into the main theme}
styles: seamless loop back to the start of the theme
